test_set_data_parallel_facade: test that set_data_parallel_facade correctly assigns and retrieves a custom DataParallelFacade on a module
test_get_data_parallel_facade_non_dp: test that get_data_parallel_facade returns a NoopDataParallelFacade when the module has no facade set
create_data_parallel_facade_subclass: create a subclass of DataParallelFacade implementing state_dict, load_state_dict, no_sync, clip_grad_norm, and summon_full_parameters
set_data_parallel_facade_on_module: set a custom DataParallelFacade instance on a torch.nn.Module using set_data_parallel_facade
get_data_parallel_facade_from_module: get the DataParallelFacade attached to a torch.nn.Module using get_data_parallel_facade
